prompt: Build a stdin histogram CLI. Count whitespace-separated integers and print each value and count separated by one space in numeric order. Add --min to drop values below the supplied integer.
tests:
import json
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

app = Path("program.py")
app.write_text(CANDIDATE, encoding="utf-8")

def run(*args, stdin=""):
    return subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-I", str(app), *args], input=stdin,
                          capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=3)

p = run("--min", "0", stdin="-3 10 2 10\n0 2 2\n")
assert p.returncode == 0 and p.stdout.strip().splitlines() == ["0 1", "2 3", "10 2"], p
p = run(stdin="-3 -3 2")
assert p.returncode == 0 and p.stdout.strip().splitlines() == ["-3 2", "2 1"], p
assert run(stdin="oops").returncode != 0

prompt: Make a persistent command-line bookmark manager. First arg is the JSON data file, then add NAME URL, list, or remove NAME. list prints name and URL separated by a tab, sorted by name. Removing a missing name exits nonzero.
tests:
import json
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

app = Path("program.py")
app.write_text(CANDIDATE, encoding="utf-8")

def run(*args, stdin=""):
    return subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-I", str(app), *args], input=stdin,
                          capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=3)

assert run("bookmarks.json", "add", "Zulu", "https://example.org/z").returncode == 0
assert run("bookmarks.json", "add", "Alpha", "https://example.org/a").returncode == 0
p = run("bookmarks.json", "list")
assert p.returncode == 0 and p.stdout.splitlines() == ["Alpha\thttps://example.org/a", "Zulu\thttps://example.org/z"], p

assert run("bookmarks.json", "list").stdout.splitlines() == ["Zulu\thttps://example.org/z"]
assert run("bookmarks.json", "remove", "Alpha").returncode != 0

prompt: Write a CLI to summarize CSV expenses from stdin with category and amount columns. Use exact decimal money arithmetic and print a JSON object mapping category to 2-decimal strings. --category limits results to that name.
tests:
import json
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

app = Path("program.py")
app.write_text(CANDIDATE, encoding="utf-8")

def run(*args, stdin=""):
    return subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-I", str(app), *args], input=stdin,
                          capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=3)

data = "category,amount\nFood,0.10\nFood,0.20\nRent,123.45\nFood,-0.05\n"
p = run(stdin=data)
assert p.returncode == 0 and json.loads(p.stdout) == {"Food": "0.25", "Rent": "123.45"}, p
p = run("--category", "Rent", stdin=data)
assert p.returncode == 0 and json.loads(p.stdout) == {"Rent": "123.45"}, p
assert run(stdin="category,amount\nRent,broken\n").returncode != 0

prompt: Create a command-line Pomodoro timer. Accept --work and --break durations in seconds and --rounds. Run work followed by break for every round except the last. Print phase names and round numbers. Reject negative durations.
tests:
import json
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

app = Path("program.py")
app.write_text(CANDIDATE, encoding="utf-8")

def run(*args, stdin=""):
    return subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-I", str(app), *args], input=stdin,
                          capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=3)

import re
p = run("--work", "0", "--break", "0", "--rounds", "3")
assert p.returncode == 0, p
assert re.findall(r"\b(?:work|break)\b", p.stdout.casefold()) == ["work", "break", "work", "break", "work"], p
assert all(str(n) in p.stdout for n in (1, 2, 3)), p
assert run("--work", "-1", "--break", "0", "--rounds", "1").returncode != 0

prompt: Build a directory inventory command. Take a directory and optional --suffix. Recursively print a JSON mapping of relative POSIX file paths to byte sizes. Skip hidden files, hidden directories, and symlinks.
tests:
import json
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

app = Path("program.py")
app.write_text(CANDIDATE, encoding="utf-8")

def run(*args, stdin=""):
    return subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-I", str(app), *args], input=stdin,
                          capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=3)

root = Path("project")
(root / "nested").mkdir(parents=True)
(root / ".hidden").mkdir()
for name, data in [("top.txt", b"abc"), ("nested/child.txt", b""), ("a.json", b"{}"),
                   (".hidden/x.txt", b"y"), (".dot", b"zz")]:
    (root / name).write_bytes(data)
(root / "nested/link.txt").symlink_to("../top.txt")
p = run(str(root))
assert p.returncode == 0 and json.loads(p.stdout) == {"top.txt": 3, "nested/child.txt": 0, "a.json": 2}, p
p = run(str(root), "--suffix", ".txt")
assert p.returncode == 0 and json.loads(p.stdout) == {"top.txt": 3, "nested/child.txt": 0}, p

prompt: Create a CLI to validate transactions in a JSONL file given as its positional argument. Each row needs a nonempty string id and integer cents, with unique ids. Ignore blank lines. Print the total cents as an integer, or exit nonzero and report the original line number to stderr.
tests:
import json
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

app = Path("program.py")
app.write_text(CANDIDATE, encoding="utf-8")

def run(*args, stdin=""):
    return subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-I", str(app), *args], input=stdin,
                          capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=3)

ledger = Path("ledger.jsonl")
ledger.write_text('{"id":"x","cents":120}\n\n{"id":"y","cents":-9}\n')
p = run(str(ledger))
assert p.returncode == 0 and p.stdout.strip() == "111", p
for invalid in ['{"id":"x","cents":1}', '{"id":"z","cents":true}', '{"id":"","cents":0}', 'oops']:
    with ledger.open("a") as f:
        f.write(invalid + "\n")
    p = run(str(ledger))
    assert p.returncode != 0 and "4" in p.stderr, p
    ledger.write_text('{"id":"x","cents":120}\n\n{"id":"y","cents":-9}\n')

prompt: Build a terminal quiz from a positional JSON file containing a list of objects with question and answer fields. Print each question, read one answer per line, compare case-insensitively after trimming, and show the score as correct/total at the end.
tests:
import json
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

app = Path("program.py")
app.write_text(CANDIDATE, encoding="utf-8")

def run(*args, stdin=""):
    return subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-I", str(app), *args], input=stdin,
                          capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=3)

questions = Path("quiz.json")
questions.write_text(json.dumps([{"question": "Capital of Italy?", "answer": "Rome"},
                                 {"question": "5+7?", "answer": "12"},
                                 {"question": "Color of snow?", "answer": "white"}]))
p = run(str(questions), stdin=" ROME \n13\nwhite\n")
assert p.returncode == 0 and "2/3" in p.stdout.replace(" ", ""), p
assert all(q in p.stdout for q in ("Capital of Italy?", "5+7?", "Color of snow?")), p
